name: residual-p2
description: RESIDUAL LEAVES AT PLY 2 (written 2026-11-12 ~21:55 by the residual fork; NOT launched by it; the coordinator launches). The user approved residual leaves 11-12 ~21:48 ("sure let's try residual leaves") after the coordinator's explanation (a shared trunk trained on every position plus a per-leaf correction). Design: analyst 6.98: chessai-hybrid6rp's residual probit leaves ARE the wanted trunk + residual, hierarchical: every delegator's shadow trains on every example through it and a leaf predicts shadow + delta, so the trunk tracks the moving ply-2 stream at the flat's speed whatever the leaf's share (the data lag of 6.43-6.46, where it bites). Flags: the std's capped T-P-Ne exactly + --leaf-residual --residual-inherit-sums (the delta starts as the plain copy and moves as a plain leaf would; NOT the non-inherit form, which also changes the predictions' spread). Pure ply 2 FROM SCRATCH (a warm start would confound the lag with the rung); one seed (70; ply-2 run-to-run SD ~5; a second seed only if the result lands 15-40). Lines x2: F-P (hybrid6), T-P-Ne capped (hybrid6), the same + residual (hybrid6rp; flags off it trains byte-identically to hybrid6, checked on T-P-Ne by the residual fork). Settings as the standard: 1,584 games, self-games, cold T 0.02 share 0.5 rating-only, rate_every 4, crowning at 3 draw-aware SEs, plateau scaled sqrt guard_z 1, floor 300, cap 400; tournament chessai-hybrid20. READS: against y + v + l @299 (replay-p2, diversity-p2, probit-late-p2: F-P x2 and T-P-Ne capped x2 each) at v150, v300 and the final, plies 2 and 1. BANDS (ply 2): residual - capped 20..60 (centre 35); residual - F-P -10..40 (centre 15); ply 1: residual - capped -20..20. RULES: 30+ over capped at ply 2 => the trunk beats the lag (next: a ply-3 twin and a shrunk-delta variant); within 15 => the partition has nothing to add at ply 2. Prior: the LR T3 run (Nov 10, mixed plies, 400 cycles) showed no lasting gain; 6.98: not evidence against (no lag at ply 1, other regime, LR deltas had the dead-step defect). Honest expectation 20-60 over the capped tree, level with or a little above F-P. Cost ~5-7 CPU-h.
